38. 
  (a) Except as provided for in headings 9903.74.03, 9903.74.05, 9903.74.06, and 9903.74.07, headings 9903.74.01 and 9903.74.02 provide the ordinary customs duty treatment of mediumand heavyduty vehicles of all countries. context.text: 1. This subchapter contains the temporary modifications of the provisions in the tariff schedule established pursuant to trade legislation. Unless otherwise stated, the modified provisions are effective until suspended or terminated. Unless the context requires otherwise, any article described in the provisions of this subchapter, for which rates of duty are herein provided, if entered during the period specified, is subject to duty at the rate set forth herein in lieu of the rate provided therefor in chapters 1 to 98.
